headline: Iran asserts control on Hormuz transit as US intensifies blockade
summary: Iran is asserting control over transit through the Strait of Hormuz as the US intensifies its blockade. Both sides are discussing extending a fragile ceasefire amid tensions over the key oil shipping lane.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a chokepoint through which a large share of global seaborne oil passes, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Iran is asserting control over transit in the Strait of Hormuz while the US intensifies its blockade. The strait carries key global oil supplies, so the dispute raises supply concerns.
